svg.textArea: DRAFT 2026-11-13, drawn from context/docs/gtm-system.md. Untested. Row 1 reads left to right, row 2 right to left, row 3 left to right.
svg.text: 2 Route, find people, find emails (steps 6 to 8)
3 Send, sort replies, CRM, weekly loop (steps 9 to 12)

rect.data-content:
1A Context OS
ICP, personas, signal matrix, facts, rules

1B Buying signals
• DM-to-order and food posts
• Hiring a CS or order rep
• New Meta ad
• "Couldn't reach" reviews
• New opening

1D Find companies
One account per Instagram handle or Maps place ID

1F Enrich
Profile, Maps, reviews, ads; AI tags vertical

1I Tier the account
A: 2+ signals. B: 1 signal

2B S1 Instagram retail
Instagram bio as business desk

2C S2 Food
Take orders without taking every call

2D S3 Salons
Turn "Are you available?" into a booking

2E Pick the opener
Strongest signal leads; competitor seen means a factual comparison

2F Find people
Owner from bio, Maps replies, CAC, LinkedIn; else the business team

2G Find and verify email
Domain: waterfall. No domain: public profile email
No email or LinkedIn: manual DM queue

2I Assign tracks
• Valid: email track
• Catch-all: low-volume pool
• LinkedIn found: LinkedIn track

3A Send the sequence
• 4 emails, 2 LinkedIn touches, 14 days
• Inbox test first
• Fredrick approves launch

3B Sort replies
AI classifies; low confidence goes to a human

3F Weekly review
Kill or keep signals; update ICP, personas, learnings
Every Monday: results update the Context OS
